name: What is the process for a design-build home addition with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for a design-build home addition with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our design-build process for a home addition begins with an in-depth consultation to understand your needs and vision. We then move into scope development and CAD-supported layout planning, followed by thorough permit coordination. Construction proceeds with structural integration, careful attention to interior finishes, and exterior tie-in work to ensure a cohesive result. This managed process, unified under one team, removes the burden of coordinating multiple vendors, ensuring clear communication and a seamless homeowner experience from concept to completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: The AKN design-build addition process covers consultation, design, permit coordination, construction, and final integration, all managed by one team.
